get.summary: Product image bytes served from S3 by the catalog.

302.description: Redirect to an external HTTPS image

post.summary: Upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image of at most 5 MB.
Stop a published sale early. New purchases are rejected as INACTIVE; held reservations finish normally. Returns 409 SALE_NOT_ACTIVE when the sale has already ended or is still being published.
Start a bounded flash crowd against a sale. Only one burst runs at a time (409 BURST_RUNNING); 501 when the deployment has no customer token.

regular_price.description: Optional everyday price that flash-sale prices are compared with.

reason.description: Why the order was cancelled, for example PAYMENT_DECLINED.

Payment.description: Simulated payment. The payment ID equals the order and attempt ID.

simulated_decline.description: True when the attempt ID starts with "decline-", the storefront's declining test card.

StockLevel.description: Authoritative stock for one published sale.

image_url.description: Store this value in the product's image_url.

Price.description: An amount in the currency's minor unit, such as paise for INR.

LoadBurst.description: A bounded flash crowd that the Flash Sale Manager sends to the Admission Controller for demonstrations.
